other_failure_modes.name: Cross-Validation Data Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Several data transformations—such as median imputation, TF-IDF vectorization, TruncatedSVD, and group aggregations—are applied to the entire training dataset before cross-validation splitting. This leaks validation fold information into the training folds, making out-of-fold evaluation scores overly optimistic.

other_failure_modes.name: Test Data Leakage in Categorical Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent concatenates training and test datasets to determine the unique categories for label encoding. In a real-world scenario where test data is unseen, the encoder should be fitted solely on the training data and be designed to handle unseen categories gracefully.

summary: The agent developed an exceptionally strong and comprehensive pipeline, utilizing advanced NLP feature extraction, out-of-fold target encoding, deep learning, tree models, and rigorous SLSQP ensemble blending. The primary flaws are minor data leakages: test data is used to define the categorical encoding vocabulary, and global transformations (like TF-IDF and imputation) are applied prior to cross-validation, which leaks validation statistics into the training folds.
